status: Frozen test-only preregistration. No idle TouchVoice/global optimization, backend, speedup or DSP source change has been implemented or measured.
target: Prospective exact fixed-state scheduling of the eight independent TWS touch circuits and selected memoryless global readouts in warmed quiet-idle; no oscillator/filter/output/FX state may be skipped merely because audio is silent.

frozen.preregistration_before_production: The complete original TouchVoice/Coefficients/TRG5 source was frozen under a different namespace before any proposed fixed-point optimization. No optimized function or shared numerical helper is called by the frozen oracle.
frozen.scope: A frozen software-continuation oracle; not an independent hardware measurement or authority to change an inferred circuit constant.

touch_fixtures.denormal_modes: All supported x86 MXCSR FTZ/DAZ combinations; AArch64 FPCR.FZ combinations when available; unknown target reports unavailable instead of inventing support.
touch_fixtures.state_events: Cold reset, mixed independent lane pressure, strike triggering at sample offsets128/257/4097, lane0 copy to lane7 at512, lane6 reset at2048, long settled intervals and later wake while other lanes continue.
touch_fixtures.public_bit_fields: Every sample: exact binary64 a, b and signed C, observable state() a/b/C (no pointer/padding), coefficient a/c/acquire/leak/contact/window terms, and exact TRG5 diode bus volts with two original Newton iterations.
touch_fixtures.fp_controls: Original and frozen function calls must preserve rounding, FTZ/DAZ and other caller control bits. At selected cold/press/wake samples, pre-raise FE_INEXACT and verify the candidate does not clear the caller's sticky exception status.
touch_fixtures.signed_zero: Under non-nearest rounding, exact-zero subtraction may have a different zero sign. A candidate must reproduce the original output C sign bit and future continuation in every qualified FP mode; hardcoded C=-0 or clearing FE flags is prohibited. Unsupported modes must take the unchanged scalar path.

engine_fixture.events: notes at frames17/2049/4097/150001, pressure at257, note-off at513/2305/4353/150257, ribbon at769, long cold/steady gaps and reacquisition after roughly three seconds of idle.
engine_fixture.policies: PURE isolation at exact analog-noise0 and sourcePerformance with modern drive FX and deterministic nonzero noise. Default source-rank audio model remains unchanged.
engine_fixture.public_samples: All interleaved float stereo audio samples, eight VoiceInfo TWS A/B/C and allocation fields, per-rank HP/LP cutoff/envelope/Q/key/oscillator readouts, 32 shared Q ports and 16 LC ports plus buses, and three always-clocked output tap capacitor/readout nodes, observed at aligned 256-frame checkpoints.
engine_fixture.required: For each source policy, the full 1/17/256 audio and global/readout rolling fingerprints must agree bitwise across partitions. On the preregistered Linux GCC13.3/glibc2.39 reference host, each also equals its immutable original-source fingerprint in the manifest. FNV-1a digests are regression sentinels, not mathematically collision-free proof of byte identity; strict V2 byte captures remain mandatory.
engine_fixture.cross_platform: Do not compare the Linux/glibc whole-engine fingerprint to a different host/compiler/libm and claim a sound-law failure. Preserve exact TouchVoice bits against the frozen same-compiler original plus partition equality; qualify a separately frozen original-engine reference before accepting an optimized source on another target.

fastpath_constraints.fixed_state: Only an exactly proven IEEE fixed-point state may use a shortcut. The input pressure, acquisition elapsed/window, b-hold capacitor, C coupling memory, leak coefficient, model/rate changes, active pending trigger and all nonzero histories must be checked; an audio gate or absence of held notes alone is insufficient.
fastpath_constraints.effects: Always preserve the TRG5 pressure bus's Newton initial guess and previous result, source readout cache invalidation, envelope/TWS clocks, sub-modulation and RNG state, BBD and PRA/output capacitor tails, listening output, retained downsample phase and first wake sample. The known `updateSourceReadouts` already memoizes unchanged common Q/LC network algebra; do not duplicate that work as a fictitious gain.
fastpath_constraints.arithmetic: No fast-math, contraction change, reciprocal approximation, global FP-mode override, smoothing re-pin or control-parameter switch. No new hardware-law inference may be attributed to an exact software optimization.
fastpath_constraints.compatibility: All existing original scalar, circuit, TWS, touch bus, idle/wake, click, legacy tails, V1 and strict V2 byte captures and other CTest physical/continuity gates remain authoritative.

true_work_witness_before_acceptance.status: Registered now, not implemented in original-source control; no claimed work reduction.
true_work_witness_before_acceptance.method: In a test-only source-instrumented candidate build, increment at actual TouchVoice full-tick versus qualified fixed-state fast-branch entry; separately count every lane's state commit, each real shared TRG5 bus solve and source readout/EG call. No synthetic wrapper flags, no shipping telemetry and no skipped externally visible clock.
true_work_witness_before_acceptance.minimum: Qualified quiet-idle fixture must execute at least one real fast-state source branch in each of eight lanes and a lower genuine full-recursion count than the frozen scalar baseline while exactly preserving every output/state/FP field; active/wake/control/foreign-FP runs must report scalar fallbacks when required.
true_work_witness_before_acceptance.negative: Force unconditional scalar path under qualified fixed state or falsify a reported fast-state count; must compile and fail a named real backend-work assertion. Force one stale TWS memory/elapsed state or wrong C zero sign; must fail the frozen state oracle with exit1.

negative_controls.CS80_TOUCH_IDLE_MUTATE_ZERO_SIGN: Flip the sign bit of one candidate C output; require FAIL touch.C.signedZeroAndWake with exit1.
negative_controls.CS80_TOUCH_IDLE_MUTATE_CROSS_LANE: Add candidate-only pressure to a neighboring idle lane; require FAIL touch.a with exit1.
negative_controls.CS80_TOUCH_IDLE_MUTATE_BUS: Contaminate a neighboring diode-bus coordinate, with all per-lane current states still otherwise correct; require FAIL TRG5.busVolts with exit1.
negative_controls.CS80_TOUCH_IDLE_MUTATE_ENGINE_GOLDEN: Alter the source-engine audio digest identically for all three partitions. Intra-engine partition equality remains green, while independent original audio golden must fail named engine.frozenAudioBits with exit1 on the qualified host.
negative_controls.CS80_TOUCH_IDLE_MUTATE_STICKY: Clear FE_INEXACT immediately after candidate TouchVoice tick; require FAIL touch.candidateStickyFlagsPreserved with exit1.
negative_controls.future_actual_source_mutations: Compile/run candidate source mutations of zero-sign, missing wake, stale b/memory, masked lane/changed bus, FP sticky clearing, and defeated fast-branch work gate. Ordinary named assertion exit1 is necessary; compiler failure, crash, timeout or rewritten fixture is not a kill.

cpu_and_release.profile: Stock quiet-idle gprof: tickGlobals17.96%, updateSourceReadouts12.86%, tickOutput9.53%, mixBus8.43%, beginSmoothedControls7.10%, BBD6.65%, FilterEnv5.76%, rank6.87%; phase process nearly absent. These are instrumented sampled CPU shares, not production RTF.
cpu_and_release.hard_targets: At 48000 Hz / 256 / 8 voices, source warmed-held RTF 0.15–0.20, source quiet-idle RTF <=0.02; both still RED. A TWS-only fast path is not expected to close the full 3x idle gap.
cpu_and_release.timing: Before ANY candidate production source optimization, get three serial uncontended same-host baseline rounds. After all frozen/mutation/compat tests pass, get three serial uncontended same-host candidate rounds of unchanged cs80_source_factory_benchmark; preserve original 51 fixture IDs and checksum/peak/RMS, all raw outliers, held/moving/idle, p99 and deadline misses plus Legacy control. Do not infer CPU gate from an instrumented work counter, gprof or isolated microbenchmark.
cpu_and_release.publication: Preregistration is test-only and cannot change source, pin, control law, PR6/main/release. No optimized code publication until strict byte/circuit gates and hard absolute CPU targets are met; rejected microexperiments remain separate labeled branches.
